drills.name: Ladder: Two Feet In
steps: Stand tall at the end of the ladder, weight on the balls of the feet.
Step both feet into the first rung, left then right, as fast as you can.
Move straight to the next rung without pausing between them.
Keep the arms driving; do not let them go still.
Walk back for recovery and repeat six times.

drills.name: Ladder: Lateral In-Out
steps: Stand side on at the bottom left of the ladder.
Step the lead foot in, then the trail foot in.
Step the lead foot out the far side, then the trail foot out.
Travel the whole length facing the same direction, then repeat facing the other way.
Four lengths each side.

drills.name: Cone: T-Drill
steps: Set one cone at the start and one ten metres straight ahead.
Place two more cones five metres either side of the far cone.
Sprint forward to the middle cone and touch it.
Shuffle left, touch, shuffle right across to the far cone, touch.
Shuffle back to the middle and backpedal to the start. Six reps.

drills.name: Cone: 5-10-5
steps: Place three cones in a line five metres apart.
Start at the middle cone in an athletic stance.
Sprint five metres to one side and touch the line.
Turn and sprint ten metres to the far cone and touch.
Turn and sprint five metres back through the middle. Six reps with full recovery.

drills.name: Cone: Box Drill
steps: Set four cones in a five-metre square.
Sprint forward along the first side.
Shuffle sideways along the second.
Backpedal along the third.
Shuffle back to the start along the fourth. Three laps each direction.

drills.name: Mirror Drill
steps: Face a partner about two metres apart between two cones.
The leader moves side to side at random without warning.
The follower mirrors every movement, staying square.
Work for twenty seconds, then swap roles.
Six rounds each, resting fully between them.
